definitions: Non-Oxford British English standard spelling of memorize.

blocks.text: Memorization is the process of committing something to memory. It is a mental process undertaken in order to store in memory for later recall visual, auditory, or tactical information.

images.alt: Memorizing or reviewing German-English vocabulary using flashcard software Anki, thus practicing active recall. First, only the question is displayed. Then the answer is displayed too, for verification.
